title: Fourier coefficient after sparse approximation
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, let $\mathcal F$ be a finite family of subsets of $[n]$, let $c$ assign a real coefficient to each subset of $[n]$, and let $T\subseteq[n]$. The Fourier coefficient at $T$ of $f$ minus the sparse polynomial $\sum_{S\in\mathcal F} c(S)\chi_S$ equals $\widehat f(T)-c(T)$ if $T\in\mathcal F$, and equals $\widehat f(T)$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
$\mathcal F$ is a finite family of subsets of $[n]$
$c$ assigns a real number to every subset of $[n]$
